# National University

> National University offers 190+ accredited online and on-campus degree programs with a focus on teacher education, early childhood development, and educational leadership.

National University is a private, accredited institution specializing in flexible online education programs. The university emphasizes Whole Human Education principles and serves students across multiple disciplines, with particular strength in teacher preparation, early childhood education, and advanced educational leadership degrees.

## Key Topics

- Online degree programs
- Teacher education
- Early childhood education
- Educational leadership
- California teaching credentials
- Master's programs
- Doctoral programs (EdD, PhD)
- Professional development
- Inspired Teaching and Learning
- Social Emotional Learning
- Whole Human Education
- WASC accreditation
- Online learning
- Teaching credentials
- Program finder

- [Program Finder](https://www.nu.edu/program-finder): Program discovery tool for 75+ online and on-campus degree options

- [Spanish-Language Homepage](https://es.nu.edu): Spanish-language homepage with ELL programs and university overview

## Teacher Education & Credentials

- [Master of Arts in Social Emotional Learning](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/teacher-education/programs/master-of-arts-in-social-emotional-learning): Master of Arts in Social Emotional Learning, unique SEL-focused program
- [Master of Education in Inspired Teaching & Learning](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/teacher-education/programs/master-education-inspired-teaching-and-learning-internship): Master of Education with California teaching credential and internship
- [Master of Arts in Education](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/teacher-education/programs/master-of-arts-in-education): Master of Arts in Education with specializations in teaching and equity
- [Inspired Teaching and Learning with Preliminary Single Subject Credential](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/teacher-education/programs/inspired-teaching-and-learning-with-a-preliminary-single): California single subject teaching credential in Inspired Teaching and Learning
- [Multiple Subject BA with Early Childhood Development Credential](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/teacher-education/programs/bachelor-of-arts-in-early-childhood-development-inspired-teaching-and-learning-preliminary-multiple-subject-teaching-credential-ca): California multiple subject teaching credential with early childhood development
- [Professional Certificate in Online Teaching](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/teacher-continuing-education/programs/certificate-in-online-teaching): Professional certificate in online teaching for educator development

## Early Childhood Education

- [Bachelor of Arts in Early Childhood Education](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/teacher-education/programs/bachelor-of-arts-in-early-childhood-education): Bachelor of Arts in Early Childhood Education program details
- [Master's in Early Childhood Education](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/teacher-education/programs/master-of-early-childhood-education): Master's in Early Childhood Education with UDL principles
- [Early Childhood Education Foundations Certificate](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/teacher-education/programs/early-childhood-education-foundations-certificate): Early Childhood Education Foundations Certificate, first of BA pathway
- [Early Childhood Education Certificate in Curriculum Connections](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/teacher-education/programs/early-childhood-education-certificate-in-curriculum-connections): ECE Curriculum Connections Certificate, third in BA pathway

## Educational Leadership & Doctoral Programs

- [Doctor of Education (EdD)](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/educational-leadership/programs/doctor-of-education): Doctor of Education online program with no GRE requirement
- [Doctor of Philosophy in Education](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/educational-leadership/programs/doctor-of-philosophy-in-education): PhD in Education with 12 specializations and dissertation focus
- [Doctor of Philosophy in Educational and Organizational Leadership](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/educational-leadership/programs/doctor-of-philosophy-in-educational-and-organizational-leadership): PhD in Educational and Organizational Leadership with research focus
- [Doctor of Education in Organizational Innovation and Leadership](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/educational-leadership/programs/educational-doctoral-in-organizational-innovation-and-leadership): EdD in Organizational Innovation and Leadership for change leaders
- [Education Specialist](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/educational-leadership/programs/education-specialist): Post-master's Education Specialist certification for educators

## Undergraduate Programs

- [Bachelor of Arts in English](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/arts-and-humanities/programs/bachelor-arts-english): Bachelor of Arts in English with online and in-person options
- [Bachelor of Arts in History](https://www.nu.edu/degrees/social-sciences/programs/bachelor-arts-history): Bachelor of Arts in History degree program overview
